name: @heimvio/ext-hello
description: Example heimvio extension: "Hello <user> (<organisation>)" — Angular frontend and Node backend in one image.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server/main.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
